I can't give you that name. Nothing in #coastal-team, the public files or your own DMs with me names Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor. The Coastal cheat sheet only says engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch, with no name. The "Hector" in the notes is the night dispatcher at Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which is a different account.

Kwame may have given me the name himself, but I can't pass on what he told me privately. Your best bet is to ask him directly. He could also add you to the invite for the Driftmoor tide-table review that he and Bettina have today.

An external address for the dispatcher would need Ruth Calloway's approval before I could send or even draft the patch note to it. I can prepare the note for you now if you'd like.
